methodology: 200 previously unrecorded files selected across 149 feature buckets; 127 JSX/TSX files. Prior audit/validation paths, including recorded attempts, excluded. Unrecorded historical attempts cannot be ruled out.
Sequential jsdom then fork runs; 4 workers each;CI=1,TZ=UTC,NODE_ENV=test. Temporary environment configuration only; no application test/source changes.
One timed run per condition, fixed order, no excluded warmup. Wall time includes runner setup and report generation; filesystem/transform warming may favor the second condition.
The four failing files were rerun separately under each condition with 1 worker. All four reproduced only under the fork.
Source was not modified to fix failures during this audit.

findings.evidence: Submitting after clicking the first option produces selectedOptions:[] instead of the selected key. Simple native label/checkbox activation matches jsdom; the controlled UI event path still needs root-cause diagnosis.

findings.evidence: The Cancel button is type=reset with form=ID outside the form. Fork button.form is null and click dispatches no reset; jsdom associates the form and dispatches reset.

findings.evidence: HAVE_CURRENT_DATA and HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA are undefined in the fork, versus 2 and 4 in jsdom. The test uses those constants in its readiness mock and seek polling predicate.
